body: Persona Q2: New Cinema Labyrinth is Atlus' Nintendo 3DS dungeon role-playing crossover bringing Persona 5's Phantom Thieves together with characters from Persona 3 and Persona 4. Trapped around a mysterious cinema, the assembled cast explores labyrinths based on the films being screened. The setting gives each expedition a different fictional world while the theatre provides a place to return. First-person exploration, drawn maps and turn-based battles connect the new film premise with the dungeon structure established by the earlier Persona Q adventure on the same handheld.

Exploration presents the party's viewpoint on the upper screen and a developing map below. Players can record the layout themselves or use automatic mapping support, marking useful details as routes become familiar. Random battles share the labyrinths with visible, powerful enemies whose presence must be considered while moving through the space. Party members use both their own Personas and additional sub-Personas, giving preparation several layers. Choosing who enters a film affects the available abilities, while the map preserves what the player has learned about its physical arrangement.

Special Screenings provide additional encounters and interactions between characters from the different original games. Completing them can unlock combined abilities, giving those meetings a practical connection with the battle system. The cinema setting allows familiar personalities to meet outside their usual stories, while the films provide a succession of shared problems. The large cast makes party selection part of the crossover's appeal. A return to the theatre offers another opportunity to change the group, follow a new interaction and see how a different combination approaches the next expedition.
